packcore.midnightconfig.title: PackCore Settings
packcore.midnightconfig.showRamWarningTo: Show a toast when less than 3GB of RAM is allocated.

config.packcore.showBetaUpdateNotificati: Show a notification when a beta pre-release is available. Only enable if you want to test less stable builds.

packcore.midnightconfig.menuStyle.toolti:
Controls which title screen style is used.
Modern: fully custom branded screen with a custom background.
Modern Minimal: fully custom branded screen with the vanilla panorama.
Minimal: vanilla-style screen with quick-join and social buttons added.
packcore.midnightconfig.serverAddressFor: The server address used by the Join button on the main menu.
packcore.midnightconfig.autoBackupEnable: Automatically create a backup when you log in after not playing for a while.
packcore.midnightconfig.autoBackupInterv: How many days must pass before a new automatic backup is triggered (1–90).

gui.packcore.wizard.page.main_menu_desig: Select how your main menu should look. Modern gives the game a custom SkyBlock-branded look. Modern Minimal uses the same layout but with the vanilla panorama background. Minimal adds quick-join and social buttons to the standard Minecraft menu.
gui.packcore.wizard.menu_design.modern.d: A fully custom main menu designed to give the game the look and feel of the official Hypixel SkyBlock game rather than Minecraft.
gui.packcore.wizard.menu_design.modern_m: The same custom layout as Modern, but uses the vanilla Minecraft panorama instead of a custom background image.
A custom main menu based on the vanilla style, with quick-join, social, and update buttons added.
Reduces visual quality to maximize frame rate.
gui.packcore.wizard.performance.balanced: A balance between performance and visuals. Recommended for most systems.
Prioritizes visual quality over frame rate. Recommended for mid-range hardware.
gui.packcore.wizard.performance.quality_: Quality settings with lightweight shaders that add visual polish with minimal FPS impact.
High quality settings with demanding shaders. Requires a powerful GPU.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.tab_design.expl: Choose a tab list style. Compact (from SkyHanni) shows more information in a condensed layout with a vanilla look. Fancy (from Skyblocker) uses a more decorative and styled display.
gui.packcore.wizard.tab_design.compact.d: A condensed tab list from SkyHanni.
gui.packcore.wizard.tab_design.fancy.des: A decorative styled tab list from Skyblocker.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.item_background: Choose how items appear in your inventory. All options come from Skyblocker. None keeps the default Minecraft look, while Circle and Square add a styled background behind each item slot that matches the item rarity color.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.none: Default Minecraft item appearance with no background.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.circ: Adds a circular background behind each item.
gui.packcore.wizard.item_background.squa: Adds a square background behind each item.
Choose how your SkyBlock storage is displayed. Overlay shows a full storage interface with all pages visible at once. Vanilla keeps the default chest look but adds tooltips that show what each page contains when you hover over it.
gui.packcore.wizard.storage_design.overl: A full storage interface with all pages and their contents visible at once.
gui.packcore.wizard.storage_design.vanil: Default chest appearance with tooltips that show each page's contents on hover.
gui.packcore.wizard.caxton_font.label: Choose a font — Caxton renders TrueType fonts in-game via a resource pack.
gui.packcore.wizard.caxton_font.none.des: Uses the standard Minecraft font. No resource pack is applied.
gui.packcore.wizard.caxton_font.open_san: A clean, humanist sans-serif font. Highly legible at small sizes and a great general-purpose choice.
gui.packcore.wizard.caxton_font.inter.de: A modern sans-serif designed for screen readability. Used in many apps and UI toolkits.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.scamscreener.ex: Configure how aggressively ScamScreener should warn and whether warning messages should ping you in chat.
gui.packcore.wizard.scamscreener.pings.h: Choose which ScamScreener warning types should play a ping in chat.
gui.packcore.wizard.scamscreener.minimum: Show all ScamScreener warnings, including low-confidence alerts. ⚠ Higher chance of false positives!
Hide low-confidence alerts and only warn when risk is medium or higher. Best default for most players.
Only surface stronger warnings with a lower chance of false positives.
Only show the most severe warnings.
gui.packcore.wizard.scamscreener.pings.r: Enable the chat ping when ScamScreener raises a normal risk warning.
gui.packcore.wizard.scamscreener.pings.b: Enable the chat ping when ScamScreener detects a blacklist warning.
gui.packcore.wizard.page.sword_block.exp: Choose whether to enable the sword blocking animation from ScaleMe. When enabled, holding right click with a sword will display the classic blocking pose from 1.8.9.
Holding right click with a sword will show the blocking animation.
gui.packcore.wizard.sword_block.disabled: No blocking animation will be shown when holding right click with a sword.
gui.packcore.wizard.resource_pack.none_f: No resource packs were found in your resource packs folder. Add resource packs there and reopen the wizard.
